novels.author: MonoSilence
novels.title: Shadow Slave | Sleepless Dreamer Novel
novels.description:
In a Quadrant known as North America, a 16-year-old soldier named Hope encounters the Nightmare Spell—an infection that forever alters his existence. The curse grants him an agonizing gift: an endless capacity to remember every moment with perfect clarity, while simultaneously causing the world to forget he exists. His life, once defined by simple military purpose, shatters under the weight of this contradiction.
Born into a dystopian realm where magic and gunfire shape survival, Hope never dreamed of becoming Awakened. Yet the Spell's twisted effects thrust him into a journey he never chose, where each decision seems to pull him further from safety rather than toward it. As obstacles grow increasingly insurmountable, he begins questioning whether the Dream Realm and reality operate by different rules entirely.
Set before Sunny's arrival in the Shadow Slave universe, this story chronicles Hope's struggle to understand his cursed nature and uncover his true role in a transformed world. Is he capable of heroism? Can he redefine what it means to be legendary?
This spin-off explores how civilization adapts to the Spell's devastation across different nations—some pursuing justice while others descend into desperation that challenges human morality. Easter eggs and references to the original narrative are scattered throughout, blending canon elements with this unique perspective. As a debut author's work, this novel prioritizes character-driven storytelling and worldbuilding depth over stylistic similarity to its source material. Constructive feedback and critique are appreciated as this author grows.

novels.author: monosilence
novels.title: Sleepless Dreamer | Shadow Slave World
novels.description:
Set in the Shadow Slave world...

...a time before Sunny was born.

This story follows a simple soldier who must survive in a dystopian, apocalyptic landscape where magic and gun warfare collide.

In a far-off Quadrant known as North America, a young soldier named Hope is 16 years old when he gets infected by the Nightmare Spell. He passed! But...he feels a bit scammed...?

A flaw that makes him fade from people's memories...

A cursed attribute that makes him remember everything endlessly in eternal wakefulness...

It's as if the Spell is twisting his future and existence into an almost improbable one.

All he has ever known his purpose to be was to serve as a simple soldier. Not too powerful. But not so weak either. And maybe, just maybe like some others, become an Awakened. Although he never dreamt of being one.

Now that his whole life is compromised after his First Nightmare, his first objective is to survive on his own. But as he tries to escape his fate, his actions seem to lead him further from his goal.

He struggles against obstacles that slowly grow bigger and out of proportion.

Maybe the Dream Realm and the Real World aren't so different than one may think.

Hope's journey involves uncovering secrets and gaining knowledge about his true nature and his new role in the world.

Is he fit to be a hero?

Could he redefine it?

***

Cover Art: @ellieaedon

novels.author: ItsTheCaptain
novels.genres: Kingdom Building,Psychological,Multiple Lead Characters,Strong Lead,Action,Adventure,Satire,High Fantasy,Romance Subplot
novels.title: Shadow Slave Vs. The Inheritance Cycle
novels.description:
Formerly Lost from Light and Changing Star of the Immortal Flame Clan find themselves on opposite ends of the Hadarac Desert in the soon-to-be war torn world of Alagaësia. Unaware of how or why they have been sent to this foreign realm, they must choose how they will navigate the new world, and suffer the natural consequences caused by their sudden arrival.

They are capable of shaping the path of this world irrevocably, whether they try to or not... so what will they choose? To forge bonds, allies, and companionship with the foreign races?

Perhaps rule them, better than their own naive, selfish, incompetent, and ultimately lacking leaders ever could?

Will they lead them into war? Watch and wait? Pick sides, play two or three, maybe toss a couple things on the board just to watch the sparks fly? Negotiate treaties, establish new nations, destroy or enslave races and maybe even species... who knows? It's all fair game when you might as well be a deity.

- - -

*Spoilers for Shadow Slave if you have not read past Ch. 1868.*

*Spoilers for The Inheritance Cycle if you have not completed the series.*

This work of fiction has been created for fans of either or both series, and as such, will be written with the assumption that the original works have already been completed by my readers. Attempting to follow along without having read the original stories will be difficult for new readers to understand without the copious amounts of context, but I will do my best where I can.

I urge you to go read both series if you haven't already. They are both fantastic.

Enjoy.

novels.title: Storm and Oblivion - A Shadow Slave Fanfiction
novels.description:
One day the signs of the nightmare spell appeared in the mind of Sugiro, an omen of death, or the promise of power and fame, a better life. To rise and become powerful.

He, at the very start was plunged into terror, faced with near impossible odds. A dormant tyrant. A being so fearsome that snuffing out any ordinary person’s life was like breathing.

The litany of curses and chants of death he meets shake him to his bones, he realizes that he will not survive, or so he thought. novels.author: kreakerss
novels.title: Shadow Slave: Not a very laid back life. Novel
novels.description:
In the Dream Realm, nightmare creatures emerge from darkness itself, feasting on the minds and bodies of the Awakened. Humanity teeters on the brink of extinction, consumed by the relentless Nightmare Spell that spreads across their world.
Asher finds himself thrust into Shadow Slave—the very novel he once read—yet his response defies logic. Rather than fear the monstrous horrors stalking every shadow, he embraces his new reality with reckless enthusiasm. Oblivious to the danger surrounding him, he charges forward with the survival instincts of a character written for tragedy.
His decisions defy reason. His luck defies explanation. His story defies every conventional expectation of what survival means in a world designed to devour the unprepared.
Follow Asher as he stumbles through a nightmare landscape where each choice could be his last, where monsters lurk in every shadow, and where being transported into your favorite novel proves far deadlier than fiction ever suggested. In a realm where only the cunning endure, watch an idiot somehow persist.
His journey through Shadow Slave awaits—a tale of action, mystery, and supernatural horror intertwined with unexpected comedy and romance. Enter the darkness. Discover how long an unprepared soul can survive in a world designed for his demise.

novels.author: Katakithekey
novels.title: In the Mind of Another | A Shadow Slave fanfic
novels.description:
His memories, My Burden.

The dead whisper through me and they’re not alone.

On his fifteenth birthday, Li is marked by the nightmare spell. a rite of passage for the powerless.

But what awaits him isn’t a trial… it’s a life that once belonged to someone else. A kingdom in ruin. A voice that whispers in his dreams. A form that no longer feels human.

Haunted by memories not his own and changed in ways he doesn’t yet understand, Li must survive a world where the past lives on.

Some legacies are inherited. Others are hunted.

novels.author: Mystries
novels.title: Shadow Slave : Desire of the Void [ LOTM X LoveCraft ]
associated_names: Shadow Slave : Desire of the Void
novels.description:
Victor ElderBlood was supposed to die.

Instead, he woke up in the world of Shadow Slave with an Aspect that shouldn't exist—one that echoes the powers from Beyond

He should be grateful. He knows the plot. He knows Sunny, Nephis, and Cassie. He knows what's coming.

But something is wrong.

The grey fog that brought him here wasn't the grey fog from Lord of the Mysteries. It was something else. Something ancient. Something hungry.

And now, Victor can feel it. A presence. A gaze.

Something is watching him from beyond the void.

Something that has been waiting for him.

"They say the void feels nothing."

"They're wrong."

—Victor ElderBlood

novels.author: Unknown
novels.title: Shadow Weaver
novels.description: As an aspiring game producer, Xu Yichi is resolute in her mission to create a groundbreaking traditional Chinese game. From that moment forward, she inscribed her name in history, amassed wealth, and achieved the pinnacle of success alongside the sisters in her studio. However, no one ever warned her that she would face monsters while developing games! "You young people ought not to be too conservative or feudal in your thinking~" A young girl clad in a jacket and long skirt sat at the table, munching loudly on a bag of potato chips. While snacking, she pointed at Xu Yichi's screen. "Well, you see, this 'inheritance' (chew chew chew) must first be 'transmitted' before there can be 'inheritance'—if something can't even be conveyed (chew chew chew), how can you expect anyone to 'inherit' it?" "I need you to tell the players a story, not to instruct them on stage performance!" "Go ahead, erase that lengthy and ornate introduction, and make Mu Guiying's portrait look more striking for me—oh, and that little purple clay pot playing with mud next door also wants to take part in our project (chew chew chew), remember to negotiate for more funds from that unfortunate thing." "—The Thirteen Taibao of Su Province are extremely wealthy!" Thus, under the guidance of a group of ancient demon spirits, cultural heritages on the brink of extinction finally blossomed anew in Xu Yichi's game world. [Intangible cultural heritage inheritance × cultural relics become refined] [1v1, but the emotional storyline is relatively minor, with the main focus on the plot!] Novel keywords: Shadow Weaver Record without pop-up window, Shadow Weaver Record txt download, Shadow Weaver Record latest chapter reading.

novels.author: Not Another Kevin
novels.title: Shadowstepper
novels.description:
My name is Jay Shen. I’m a street rat alchemist, a former thief, and I live above a fish market in Kowloon, my main goal right now is not getting killed.

I accepted a simple job from Grandma Zaro the herbalist. All I had to do was look and report back. Unfortunately, I misunderstood my assignment, and I may have woken something that is now wreaking havoc on the streets of Hong Kong.

Also, I may have stolen a magic dagger from a guy who just got promoted to head of a Triad clan. We’re not exactly on good terms.

I don’t think there’s a potion that can fix this, but I’ll do my best. Wish me luck.
